test_cases.title: Successful Login with Valid Credentials
steps: Enter a registered and active user email
Enter the correct password for the account
test_cases.expected_result: The user is successfully authenticated and redirected to the main dashboard.

test_cases.title: Login Fails with Unregistered Email
steps: Enter an email address not registered in the system
test_cases.expected_result: An appropriate error message indicating invalid credentials is displayed, and the user remains on the login page.

test_cases.title: Login Fails with Incorrect Password
steps: Enter a valid registered user email
test_cases.expected_result: An appropriate error message indicating invalid credentials is displayed, and login is denied.

test_cases.title: Account Temporary Lockout After Five Failed Attempts
steps: Enter a valid registered user email
Enter an incorrect password and attempt login 5 consecutive times
Attempt to log in a 6th time using the correct password
test_cases.expected_result: After the 5th failed attempt, the account is temporarily locked, preventing login even with the correct password on the 6th attempt.

test_cases.title: Password Field Masks Input Characters
steps: Focus on the password input field
test_cases.expected_result: All characters entered into the password field are masked (e.g., displayed as dots or asterisks) and never shown in plain text.

test_cases.title: Login Fails When Email Field is Empty
test_cases.expected_result: Validation prevents submission and displays an error indicating that the email field is mandatory.

test_cases.title: Login Fails When Password Field is Empty
steps: Enter a valid registered user email
test_cases.expected_result: Validation prevents submission and displays an error indicating that the password field is mandatory.

test_cases.title: SQL Injection Attempt in Email Field
steps: Enter a SQL injection payload in the email field (e.g., 'OR '1'='1)
test_cases.expected_result: The input is treated strictly as an email string, authentication fails, and an invalid credentials error is returned without exposing system internals.

test_cases.title: Regression: Successful Login Session Persistence
steps: Refresh the browser page or navigate to a protected route
test_cases.expected_result: The user remains authenticated and does not get redirected back to the login page unexpectedly.

test_cases.title: Email Field Boundary Length Validation
steps: Enter an email address exceeding standard maximum character length limits
test_cases.expected_result: System handles the overly long input gracefully by either truncating, rejecting locally, or returning a validation error message.
